work.title: Surgical ergonomics
work.summary: Motion-tracking and multimodal data workflows for research into surgical movement and workload.
work.role: Development of video-based motion-tracking workflows and support for physiological and sensor data capture and analysis.
work.evidence: Collaborative urologic-surgery ergonomics work involving video, EMG, heart-rate and motion data.
work.limitations: Research collaboration, not clinical practice or a validated surgical assessment product. No patient records or unpublished results are released here.

work.title: Proteins & molecular dynamics
work.summary: Dataset and trajectory workflows for studying protein motion and evaluating generated structural rollouts.
work.role: Data acquisition and standardization, structural plausibility checks, and computational-biophysics literature synthesis.
work.evidence: Project records describe trajectory handling and diagnostics including RMSD, radius of gyration, bond and geometry checks, and PCA/RMSF-style features.
work.limitations: Computational research and prototype work. No drug-discovery success, biological efficacy, or clinical result is claimed.

work.title: Behavior & neurobiology

work.evidence: Research experience recorded in the CV includes behavioral observation, mouse handling, genotyping workflows and tissue-collection support.
work.limitations: Collaborative, supervised laboratory work. The lab retains its own research results and publication process.
